claims: Artemis II reentry and splashdown live coverage begins around 6:30 p.m. EDT (3:30 p.m. PDT) on Friday, April 10, 2026.
NASA is streaming the Artemis II return to Earth on NASA+, YouTube, and social media.
Artemis II return to Earth is expected around 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
Netflix and Prime Video are also hosting the stream, according to WIRED.
The Orion capsule will enter the atmosphere at approximately 4:53 p.m. PDT.
The Orion capsule will experience a 6-minute communication blackout.
Live high-definition coverage shows the plasma fireball.
Live high-definition coverage shows parachute deployment.
Live high-definition coverage shows the final splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.
The capsule will land off the coast of California.
The final stages take place in daylight, notes WIRED.
